quiz.question: Which is the strongest password approach?
options: A long passphrase of random words
A short complex password changed monthly
Your pet's name plus a number
quiz.answer_text: A long passphrase of random words
quiz.why: Length beats complexity. Current NIST guidance favors long passphrases and doesn't require routine changes.
